Sandbox_LegacyJournal_TrainingMedia_tool: Controls whether watched training media are written to the journal and can be restored.
Sandbox_LegacyJournal_WriteTimeMultiplie: Adjusts the time required to write a personal journal. 1.0 is the standard speed; lower values are faster.
Sandbox_LegacyJournal_ReadTimeMultiplier: Adjusts the time required to read a personal journal. 1.0 is the standard speed and vanilla reading traits still apply.
Sandbox_LegacyJournal_RecoveryPercent_to: Sets how much recorded knowledge a personal journal restores. Skill XP is scaled numerically; recipes, read skill books, and qualifying training media are selected by their recorded counts, rounded up to one entry. Repeated reading cannot stack recovery.
